high_level_description: addCriterion The image showcases a collection of T-shirts with unique and humorous designs. The central focus is on a beige T-shirt featuring the word "Perfumer" prominently displayed at the top. Below it, there is a definition of a perfumer as a "noun," followed by a description that reads: "People serve as the scent sorcerers, blending notes and essences into bottled magic that whispers stories and evokes emotions. They're part scientist, part poet, turning flowers, spices, and woods into unforgettable fragrances that linger in memory.
